charts.note: leave one season out · 7,824 player seasons · 16/17 seasons won

entries.short: The predictive SV rate, from this season and the two before.
body: SV a 90 at weights 1, .5, .25, shrunk toward the position mean of regulars by 225 minutes (defenders 450, keepers 28,800),
minus .008 a year over age 29. Held out, next-season team GD R² goes from .634 to .650, 11 of 11 pairs,
and r with next season's SV a 90 from .690 to .718. It is the most predictive soccer metric on players.
1Y / 3Y count the two seasons before twice over, as GAR and as SVAR, pooled a 90 and shrunk with 900 minutes.
With SVAR in, the GAR prior's weight falls to about zero. Held out 1Y RMSE 1.310 to 1.305, t -2.6 (Nov 27 2026).
entries.where: Soccer SVAR leaders, depth chart, next up, backup watch xGap

entries.short: The chance an uncommitted recruit signs with each school on his recruitment list. The top school is shown in the Team cell.
body: A conditional logit over his ESPN recruitment list (3+ schools), fit walk-forward by class, with a recency weight of .75 a class (CFB).
Terms: program pull and tier, grade × tier, hometown distance, home state, conversion rate (signed / listed) and on-field Elo (CFB).

CFB also uses On3/Rivals visits (official, unofficial count, latest, last 90 days) and the confidence-weighted share of On3 expert picks. It is trained as of 30 days before each commitment, and live it uses everything to date.

Held out 2018-26 (CFB), log loss goes from 1.962 to 1.896 and top-1 from 30.4% to 32.3%. RPM % on top of the picks failed (CFB), and so did every On3 term (CBB). Leans above 80% have run about 10-20 points hot.

Coach terms (CFB, classes 2022-26 held out): a school whose head coach is gone after the recruit's senior fall is picked less (t = 6.8, log loss 1.927 to 1.924). Head coach tenure passed alone (t = 3.9) but not in every class on top of that. Failed: a first-year coach (t = 1.5), a coach who came from a school on his list (t = 1.1), and all four in CBB (t = -1.2 to 0.6).
entries.where: CFB and CBB recruit class tabs

entries.short: Each sport's power ranking, which is the game model's neutral-site rating put in order.
body: It is the same number the game model uses, so the picks already read it. It splits into parts (Elo, efficiency, talent ...).
The rank range is the 80% range of the true rank, from 4,000 draws at the rating sd measured on past seasons.
In CBB 2016-26, ARK picks the winner 77.3% of the time compared to 76.8% for the AP poll, and 77.1% compared to 76.7% for the Coaches poll.
entries.where: ARK Ranking tab on every sport page; ARKRANKING page

entries.short: Points against an average FBS team on a neutral field.
body: Elo (with a preseason prior from last season, SP+, 247 talent, returning production and transfers) + opponent-adjusted EPA/play.
Plus home, rest, travel, altitude, FCS (and the FCS side's own margin rating), special teams, P4 tier, 4th-down aggressiveness, returning production
and game control. The sim's win sd is 14.2. Current injuries are charged (Inj), and Full is the team at full strength.
entries.where: CFB ARK Ranking, games, season odds

entries.short: Expected margin against an average team on a neutral field, with this week's QB and injuries.
body: Fitted terms: Elo, starting QB, rest, home, injuries, a market rating from earlier closes, and the return game.
Injury cost = WAR a game × 36 points a win × P(miss), where questionable is .25 and doubtful is .98.
entries.where: NFL ARK Ranking, games, season odds

entries.short: Expected margin against an average D-I team on a neutral floor.
body: Fitted terms: adjusted efficiency × possessions, Elo, home, game control, conference home game, injuries,
home × attendance, ESPN BPI, form and the preseason injury report. The preseason prior comes from returning minutes, transfers and top-5 FV.
50% of three-point luck is taken out.

Market disagreement is each team's running gap between its earlier closes and the model (.2 a game, 0 at the start of the season), for spreads and totals. On lined games 2021-26, margin MAE goes from 9.057 to 9.009 (the close is 8.986) and totals from 13.401 to 13.366.
entries.where: CBB ARK Ranking, games, season odds, tournament odds

entries.short: Expected margin against an average team on a neutral floor, with the current roster and today's injury report.
body: Fitted terms: Elo, net rating, market rating, home, lineup value (XPM × minutes × chance to play), playoff Elo and rest.
25% of three-point luck is taken out. The Proj column (rest-of-season VORX) is display only.
entries.where: NBA ARK Ranking, games, season odds

entries.short: Win chance from a logistic on Elo, an expected-goals rating, back-to-backs, home and lineup value.
body: The xG rating is an opponent-adjusted ridge with a half-life of 120 days, and .7 of it carries over a season. Lineup value follows trades.
Totals use xG, goals, the market total and the starting goalie.
entries.where: NHL ARK Ranking, games, season odds

entries.short: Goals a match against an average big-five club on neutral ground, on one scale for every league.
body: An online Poisson attack and defence rating within each league, with league strength from cross-league matches only.
The inputs are blended walk-forward: market-implied goals from earlier closes, xG (Understat, FotMob) and squad value.
Dixon-Coles rho is -.04. In the big five, held out, log loss is .972 compared to .967 for the close.
entries.where: Soccer ARK Ranking, league tabs, UEFA cups, MLS

entries.short: League goal difference a match above the game model's pre-match expectation, by manager.
body: Residual = the actual 90-minute GD minus the walk-forward model's expected GD, shrunk with 40 average matches,
for managers with 100+ matches, 2012-13 to 2025-26 (Transfermarkt managers).
As a term in a manager's first 10 matches at a new club it failed (held 2023-26 t = -0.05).

entries.short: Win chance against the average top-50 player in a best of three, over the tour's 52-week surface mix.
body: Surface Elo blended with a games-won rating and opponent-adjusted serve and return point ratings (Markov chain).
It is fit on 2012-22 tour main draws. Held 2023-26, log loss is about .596, compared to .603 for Elo.
SV is season WAR for the calendar year to date, at every level, with the same credit per match as WAR.
Split-half r is .81 ATP and .82 WTA (2015 to 2025), and next-season r is .85 ATP and .84 WTA.
ARK adds the points added term, CP × pPA gap / 10 on the match blend. Next-season log loss t = -8.7, 14 of 15 seasons.
rPA is shrunk by 300 points toward 0, which moves held-out describe R² from .128 to .135 (15 of 15). WAR counts Futures and ITF at half,
and Challenger, qualifying and team events at .85 (next-season R² .083 to .085, t = -7.1). SV keeps every match in full.

entries.short: Series win chance against the average top-20 team.
body: A player Elo that follows players between rosters (per map, on round share), the bo3.gg team map rating with veto,
region offsets, Valve VRS points and the five players' mean RWA. Held out log loss is .553, compared to .667 for VRS. There are no picks, since there is no free closing odds history.
Valve lists one series up to several times under alias team names (9,624 of 37,399 rows). Repeats of a date and
both fives are dropped before every replay. Held log loss on the clean rows: ARK .6105, team RWA .6245, VRS .6640.

entries.short: A rating from results and margin, where 1500 is average.
body: CFB Elo starts from a preseason prior. In CS2 Elo, +400 is 10 to 1 odds. Tennis Elo is on wins, at every level.

entries.short: How much of each game a team spent with the win in hand.
body: A time-weighted win chance from score and clock only, opponent-adjusted and carried across seasons.
It shipped in CFB (held out MAE t = -4.1) and CBB (t = -2.0). It failed in the NBA.

entries.short: Talent is the value of the projected starters by FV, and TvE is Elo against the Elo that talent predicts, in SD.
body: CFB Talent is the sum over the projected starting 22 of expected college WAR a season at FV. A TvE above 0 means the team is playing above its talent.

entries.short: 10,000 simulated seasons from the game model.
body: The rating error sd shrinks with the season left (sd^2 = a + b × share left, measured on past seasons).
xW = wins so far + the simulated rest. The outputs are conference, playoff and title odds, with full NFL tiebreakers.
In the NHL I tested the preseason points over/under as the sim's prior, and it isn't used.
In 2014-19 there was no gain at any weight (points MAE +.01, t = +.1). In 2020-26 it was -.21 points (t = -8.8, 7/7 seasons), and playoff Brier went from .1635 to .1591.
It only held in the later seasons, so it fails the gate. It is registered for one more score after 2026-27.
entries.where: season odds tab on every team sport; ARKRANKING

entries.short: A committee model plus the bracket for the 12-team playoff.
body: A Plackett-Luce fit on the CFP releases 2017-25: losses, wins, rating, wins above bubble and P4. Held out field log loss is .029, compared to .090.
Committee memory: final score = c × model + a × (26 - CFP rank) / 25 + d × wins above bubble since the release, with a, c and d by weeks to Selection Sunday.
Fit 2017-21 and held 2022-25 (20 releases), final-ranking log lik goes from -865.9 to -714.2 (t = 4.5), and seed log loss from 2.477 to 2.422 (t = 1.8).
2026 rules: the P4 champions are in, plus the best G6 champion, and Notre Dame if it is in the top 12. The top 4 get byes.
entries.where: CFB season odds (Bye, Semis, Natl title), bracket

entries.short: Committee and bracket sims for bids, seeds and rounds.
body: The committee is fit on the 2015-26 fields from rating and wins above bubble (the 45th team), and gets 91% of at-large picks.
The conference tournaments and the bracket are played out with the game model.

entries.short: On Selection Sunday the committee model is stacked with the Bracket Matrix's final consensus.
body: Seed line = a + b × model line + c × matrix average seed.
At-large score = a + b × model logit + c × share of brackets naming the team.
Fit 2015-19 and held 2021-26. Seeds (408 teams): log loss goes from 1.257 to 1.007 (t = -3.08 by season, 5 of 6), and the exact line from 51% to 68%.
At-large (1,902 candidates): from .0507 to .0296 (t = -3.88, 5 of 6).
It is used only when the regular season is over and no bracket is out. Earlier dates are logged daily and scored once after the season.

entries.short: The title, conference and division sims against DraftKings futures, with the vig removed.
body: They are display only. The win-total backtests found no proven edge (NBA b .22, t = 3.0 in sample and t = 1.5 held out).
NHL points totals (Hockey-Reference preseason over/under, 2013-14 to 2025-26 without 2019-20, graded at -110):
the day-0 season sim misses by 9.93 points, compared to 10.15 for the line. Actual - line = .65 × (sim - line), t = 4.8 (2014-19 .93,
2021-26 .35, t = 2.6). The sim's side of every line went 191-150-2, +6.9% (season t = 1.4), and the held-out rule 54-45, +4.1% (t = .7).
There is no proven edge.
entries.where: Predictions futures tab; title odds on ARKRANKING

entries.short: Team trait medals, each on one stat, shrunk by games to a reliability of .5.
body: 59 of 72 pass the repeat test. NFL Return Game also passed against the close, and it is in the NFL model.
entries.where: ARK Ranking team dropdowns, team GFX cards

entries.short: Head coach and coordinator scores, and a coach's market value against his public pay.
body: Pay is modelled on program plus wins (USA Today data). Surplus = Value - Pay. The staff score includes zNIL growth (20%).
A coach's value-added doesn't carry to a new job (it failed the test), and the staff weights are set by hand.
entries.where: CFB staff, coach pay, coaching jobs tabs

entries.short: Men's basketball expenses from the Equity in Athletics survey go into the pay model.
body: ln(men's basketball expenses), z-scored inside the academic year, from the newest year ending before the season.
Leaving one school out, on 746 pay rows at 79 public schools, RMSE of ln pay goes from .336 to .280 and R² from .50 to .65 (t = 3.95 by school).
The drivers kept are spending, tenure, high-major and program level.
The survey covers private schools too, so their value estimate reads a measured budget.

entries.short: Head coaches ranked by Score, in wins. Score is a coach's value over what the program does with other coaches, plus titles weighted the way the Halls of Fame weigh them.
body: WAx is each season's wins over the program's expectation on a standard season (CFB 12 games, CBB 30): G × [Phi(r/s) - Phi(e/s)], where s is the decade's points-to-wins probit scale.
The expectation e comes from the seasons of the program's other coaches within 15 years (weight exp(-gap/6), skipping the 2 seasons after he leaves), shrunk 1 season toward the conference that year.
Ratings: CFB is a ridge SRS from every major-college game since 1900. CBB is Sports Reference SRS from 1950, with 1939-49 estimated from win% and conference.
cWAR = WAx + 1.23 (CFB) / 2.41 (CBB) a season. Replacement level is the mean season of coaches with two or fewer seasons.

NT / CT are national and conference title shares, with ties split. CFB national: AP from 1936, AP + Coaches Poll halves from 1950, and the share of major-selector picks before 1936. CFB conference: the title game, or else the best conference record. CBB: the NCAA title, and the regular-season conference title.
Title difficulty: log2(1 + sum exp(z/t)) over the field (z is the season rating z-score, and t = 0.25 is fit on who won), over its mean.

Score = cWAR + 52 a national title + 8.5 a conference title (CFB); 108 + 31.5 (CBB). The weights come from a logistic fit of Hall of Fame selection on cWAR, NT and CT (done by 2019, 8+ seasons; 136/443 CFB, 71/787 CBB), as the title coefficient over the cWAR coefficient.

Coord (CFB): OC/DC unit points over the program's unit expectation, 1990-2025, in wins (column). It goes into Score × 0.06, the slope of later head-coach WAx rate on coordinator rate (n 121, t = 0.46; OC r 0.09, DC r -0.07), so coordinator results barely carry. CBB has no assistant history.
Hall of Fame AUC is 0.89 for Score, compared to 0.90 for raw wins (CFB), and 0.88 compared to 0.83 (CBB).
Movers (old-job WAx rate against the new job, 3+ seasons each): CFB r 0.14 (n 373, t = 2.69), CBB r 0.20 (n 754, t = 5.51).

Walk-forward from 2010, shrunk WAx predicts the next 10 seasons' WAx at r 0.19 CFB / 0.37 CBB (win% 0.19 / 0.12), and Score per season predicts next-10 title equity at r 0.40 / 0.60 (win% 0.09 / 0.43).
Stability: the top-100 rank correlation across expectation settings (decay 3-12, shrink 1-3, no skip) is 0.97+ CFB and 0.98+ CBB. Odd/even-season WAx split-half is 0.75 / 0.82.

NBA / NHL: the same method on Sports Reference SRS (NBA points, NHL goals), with an 82-game season and the franchise as the program (one id through relocations). A league title counts as the national title, and a place in the Finals or Stanley Cup Final as the conference title. A coach replaced in season gets his share of the games. Seasons with an SRS on file: 1947-2026 / 1922-2026.

NBA / NHL replacement level is 8.61 / 5.04 wins a season, and Score = cWAR + 166 / 39 a title + 0.0 / 3.2 a Finals appearance. The Hall of Fame label is the Naismith Coach category for the NBA (17/45) and the Hockey Hall of Fame Builder category for the NHL (11/29; that Hall has no coach class, and coaches inducted as players are left out of the fit).

NBA / NHL tests: Hall of Fame AUC is 0.96 / 0.89 for Score, compared to 0.85 / 0.66 for raw wins. Movers r 0.17 (n 100, t = 1.75) / 0.15 (n 89, t = 1.4). Walk-forward from 2010, shrunk WAx to next-10 WAx is r -0.07 / -0.14 (win% 0.03 / -0.11), and Score per season to next-10 title equity is r 0.52 / -0.12 (win% 0.36 / 0.02). Split-half 0.74 / 0.86.

NFL: the same method on the all-time teams' ridge points a game (NFL, AFL and AAFC, 1920-2025), with a 17-game season and the franchise as the program (one id through relocations). Head coaches and their records come from pro-football-history.com, with an in-season change split by games. A league title counts as the national title, and a title-game season (conference championship, or the league title game before the merger) as the conference title.

NFL replacement level is 2.12 wins a season, and Score = cWAR + 0 a title + 194.4 a title-game season (Pro Football Hall of Fame coaches 21/65; coaches inducted as players are left out of the fit). Coordinator seasons carry nothing into head-coaching WAx (slope .01, t = .07, 94 coaches), so there is no coordinator term.

NFL tests: Hall of Fame AUC is 0.88 for Score, compared to 0.78 for raw wins. Movers r 0.25 (n 75, t = 2.21). Walk-forward from 2010, shrunk WAx to next-10 WAx is r 0.41 (win% 0.25), and Score per season to next-10 title equity is r 0.39 (win% 0.27). Split-half 0.71.

Era check: the mid-career decades of the top 100 by Score against every ranked coach's coached seasons by decade (a career total grows with seasons), as a KL, with the era-blind 95% line (top 100 drawn at random), and the per-season Score rate against coaches by decade: CFB 0.066 (line 0.108), rate 0.086 (line 0.108); CBB 0.077 (line 0.077), rate 0.037 (line 0.078); NBA 0.030 (line 0.075), rate 0.019 (line 0.077); NHL 0.023 (line 0.094), rate 0.019 (line 0.095); NFL 0.009 (line 0.095), rate 0.013 (line 0.093).
entries.where: all-time coaches tab on the CFB and CBB pages (market group) and the NBA and NHL pages (teams group); NFL page (teams group, all-time)

entries.short: The best team-seasons (overall, offense, defense) and the best player seasons and careers in each sport, with each season measured against its own league. It is one sport at a time, with no scale across sports.
body: Rtg+ / Off+ / Def+ = 100 + 25 z (the Stat+ scale), where z = (rating - that season's league mean) / s. s is the upper semi-deviation × sqrt 2, sqrt(2 × mean of max(rating - mean, 0)^2), pooled over the season and the two on either side. s equals the SD in a symmetric season, but it isn't stretched by a long bottom tail (a floor of 0 points allowed in low-scoring eras, blowout losers, a wide spread of weak programs). 100 is an average team that season, 125 is one s better and 175 is three.

I use z instead of raw points because scoring levels and the spread between the best and worst teams change by era (fewer, deeper leagues; 1900s college blowouts; dead-ball hockey). Dominance over the league a team played in is the number that compares across eras, and the raw rating is shown next to it.

Team ratings. CFB: a ridge SRS on every major-college game (margin capped at 35, home edge, offense and defense from the same ridge on capped points; jhowell.net scores 1900-2025). NFL: the same ridge on every NFL, AFL and AAFC game including playoffs (FiveThirtyEight scores to 1998, nflverse from 1999; 1920-2025). CBB: Sports Reference SRS / OSRS / DSRS (1950-2026). NBA: Basketball Reference SRS, ORtg and DRtg against the league average (1947-2026; off / def from 1951-52). NHL: Hockey Reference SRS, goals for and against a game against the league + half the SOS (1918-2026, no 2004-05). Soccer: big-five clubs, goals a match against the big-five average at season end (2005-2026). CS2: the best Valve VRS points in a calendar year, with each snapshot's top 50 as the league (2024-2026).
The lists are the top 250 plus the top 25 of every decade, so the Era filter shows the best of each decade. CH is a champion (CFB national title share, NFL league or Super Bowl winner).

Era check: the share of the top 100 by decade against the decade's share of all rows, as a KL divergence (0 means every decade is represented by its size), era-adjusted against raw. The line is the 95th percentile of the KL when the top 100 are drawn era-blind (4,000 multinomial draws on the decade shares), and a list passes if the adjusted number is under the line. Player lists count each player's best season once, since one player's run, such as Gretzky's eight 1980s seasons, isn't an era. Hockey prospects are binned by draft class (5 years). Teams: CFB 0.042 vs 0.319 (line 0.107); CFB 0.030 vs 0.099 (line 0.107) offense; CFB 0.090 vs 0.554 (line 0.107) defense; NFL 0.019 vs 0.209 (line 0.093); NFL 0.025 vs 0.078 (line 0.093) offense; NFL 0.024 vs 0.206 (line 0.093) defense; CBB 0.042 vs 0.115 (line 0.070); CBB 0.017 vs 0.183 (line 0.070) offense; CBB 0.038 vs 0.104 (line 0.070) defense; NBA 0.023 vs 0.022 (line 0.078); NBA 0.008 vs 0.090 (line 0.071) offense; NBA 0.014 vs 0.066 (line 0.071) defense; NHL 0.024 vs 0.384 (line 0.100); NHL 0.030 vs 0.221 (line 0.100) offense; NHL 0.041 vs 0.294 (line 0.100) defense; soccer 0.002 vs 0.078 (line 0.029); soccer 0.002 vs 0.142 (line 0.029) offense; soccer 0.023 vs 0.056 (line 0.029) defense; CS2 0.000 vs 0.000.

Players: peak seasons rank every player-season on its own (one player can hold several rows), and a career is the sum of seasons. Each season is valued over replacement in its own league and scaled to a full season where seasons were short.

NBA: VORX per 82 games (XPM is the DPM + BPM blend from 2009-10, and BPM before). Before 1973-74, BPM is estimated from WS/48 and PER (fit on 1974-85 players with 500+ minutes, r 0.90; tagged est), and minutes start in 1951-52. NHL: point shares per 82 games (Hockey Reference; skaters OPS + DPS, goalies GPS). CBB: the site's CBB VORX on every Barttorvik season from 2007-08. NFL: peak is the site's AV WAR (rebuilt AV, no special teams) from 2012 (snap counts), and career is Pro Football Reference weighted career AV (nflverse draft_picks; drafted players 1980 on). Soccer: the site's GAR, on big-five seasons from 2014-15.

Tennis: Elo on every tour-level singles match from 1968 (Sackmann archive; K = 250 / (matches + 5)^0.4, Slams × 1.1). A season is SV: that year's wins minus what a replacement player (the year's 101st to 150th by year-end Elo) would win against the same opponents, so no earlier season is in it. SV+ = 100 + 25 × (SV - the year's #20 SV) / SD of the year's top 100, years with 20+ matches. Career is the sum of the years over the #20 line in those SDs.

Era adjustment (rate + volume): a season's rate is set against that season's regulars, rate' = mean_ref + SD_ref × (rate - season mean) / season SD (SD pooled over the season and two on either side), and its volume against that season's load, vol' = vol × q_ref / q_season (q is the 90th percentile of the regulars' volume). The sport's own value formula then runs on rate' and vol'. _ref is the mean over the last 10 seasons, so the values read in today's units. Unadj is as played.

By sport. NBA: the rate is XPM and the volume is minutes per 82 team games, VORX = .030 × (XPM' + 1.4) × min' / 48 (BPM is per 100 possessions, so pace and the 3-point era are in the rate, and the volume term takes out the 45-minute loads of the 1960s). NHL: WAR per 82 against the season, with skaters and goalies apart (there is no ice time before 2008-09, so no volume term). CBB: the rate is BPM (regulars 400+ min) and the volume is minutes (the short 2020-21 season is scaled up). Soccer: the rate is GAR per 90 (regulars 900+ min) and the volume is minutes. CS2: calendar years from 2024, where the rate is RWA over that year's replacement (the median of 1,000+ round players, with opponents at their year-end ratings) and the volume is rounds (the current year to date is scaled to a full year), RAR = RWA' × rounds' / 100. Hockey prospects: drafted skaters' seasons outside the NHL (20+ games, ages 16-21), NHLe+ = 100 + 25 z of log(NHLe + 5) against drafted skaters of the same age and position that season. Tennis: Elo against the year's #20 in SDs of the year's top 100 is already a rate against the season, so there is no volume term (peak Elo).

NFL WAR seasons: rosters grew (1,734 WAR rows in 2013, 2,055 in 2021) and the top thinned, so each season's WAR is set against that season's starters at the position (the top k by WAR, where k is the position's share of rows × 704 = 32 teams × 22 starters), in the last 10 seasons' units. CFB QB and RB / WR / TE Yds+: the over-average value is multiplied by the last 10 seasons' SD over the season's SD (pooled over the season and two on either side; QBs use TAY/P of qualified passers, and skill players use AY of the season's starters at the position).

Player era check (peak list, KL as above, adjusted against as played): CFB RB / WR / TE 0.014 vs 0.041 (line 0.031); NFL 0.012 vs 0.023 (line 0.019); CBB 0.007 vs 0.025 (line 0.029); NBA 0.049 vs 0.188 (line 0.071); NHL 0.024 vs 0.706 (line 0.100); hockey prospects 0.026 vs 0.018 (line 0.039); soccer 0.003 vs 0.008 (line 0.020); CS2 0.000; ATP 0.026 (line 0.063); WTA 0.043 (line 0.063); CFB QBs 0.009 vs 0.015 (line 0.030); NFL QBs 0.000 vs 0.004 (line 0.019).
These lists are display only, and no model reads them.
entries.where: all-time tab (teams group: all-time teams, offenses, defenses) and all-time players tab (players group: peak seasons, careers) on the CFB, CBB, NFL, NBA, NHL and soccer pages; tennis all-time (ATP / WTA peaks and careers); CS2 all-time teams + all-time players; hockey prospects peak seasons

entries.short: The model line, win chance and projected score for every game.
body: The margin comes from the sport's rating (see Team ratings), and the win chance is a normal (or logistic) on the margin.
The win sd is fit walk-forward: NBA about 12, CBB 11.9, CFB 14.2. Totals have a separate model in each sport.

Soccer projects the score, over 2.5 and both-score from market totals ratings in 16 leagues (a league term and a lean for each club, learned from the closing over/under prices of earlier matches, never the match's own). Held out, over 2.5 log loss is .675 compared to .683 before, and the close is .672. 1X2 is unchanged.
Predictions is the only page with picks, lines and props. The sport pages show projections only.
The NHL win model against MoneyPuck's pregame number and the close, on the same lined games with a pregame-dated MoneyPuck file (log loss,
Stacking MoneyPuck on the model doesn't help (2024-26 n 3,684: .66825 to .66844, t = +.5), so it isn't used.
The spread of the logits against the market's, 2023-26, is 1.23-1.33 for the model and .98-1.18 for MoneyPuck.
entries.where: games and game table tabs; Predictions

entries.short: The best games of the next seven days across every sport, on a 0-100 scale.
body: W = 100 × (.30 Q + .20 C + .20 S + .20 L + .10 T) + bonus, capped at 100. It is display only, with no backtest.
Q (quality): each side is 1 - (rank - .5) / min(N, 60) in the sport's rating order, 0 past 60, and Q is the mean of the two.
C (closeness): 1 - (P home - P away)^2, as a percentile among the sport's games. T (total): projected points or goals, as a percentile.
S (stars): each side's top three players by the sport's value (NFL WAR, NBA VORX, NHL WAR, soccer GAR, college FV - 20)
× chance to play (injury tags: out / IR 0, doubtful .25, questionable / day-to-day .6; the game model's play chances first),
weighted 1 / .7 / .5, and scored by rank among the sport's teams like Q.
L (leverage): a target's swing from one result, dP = phi(Phi^-1(p)) / sqrt(n / 4 + 1 / 2), where p is the season sims' odds
and n is games left. Playoff is 1, division / bye / top four .5, and soccer title and relegation 1. Side L = min(1, sum / .35),
and game L = .6 × the higher side + .4 × the lower. Postseason games are 1. Tennis and CS2 use round and format levels.
Bonus: a named rivalry 6, a division or conference game 2, both ranked 4, one ranked 1. The list is the top 15, with at most 4 from a sport.
A listed game that starts moves to "scores" with its W frozen and its live or final score (ESPN scoreboard; tennis and CS2 from the site's files). It drops 24 hours after the final.
Source: scripts/watch_games.py to data/watch.json, every half hour.

entries.short: A second attack/defence pair from shots on target, blended into the national-team match model.
body: Target = shots on target × running goals a shot on target (about .3), with the same update as goals.
Goal means move by .15 × (shots gap - goals gap) in logs once both sides have 5 matches with ESPN stats (12 competitions,
Held 2016 to Jul 2026 on the 5,191 matches where it applies, 1X2 log loss goes from .8699 to .8680, t = -4.18, 9/11 years.

entries.short: Goal rates shift by .35 per km the venue sits above the visitor's home ground, past the first 1,000 m.
body: Gap = max(0, venue - visitor home - 1,000 m) minus the same for the home side, in km.
Elevations are SRTM 90 m at the venue city, and a nation's home elevation is the median of its home venues since 1990.
Tuned on 2000-15 (c .35, from 0 to .5). Held 2016 to Jul 2026, 9,734 matches, 464 with a gap:
log loss t = -2.59 by match day with frozen rates and -3.51 in the model (.85529 to .85402), 10 of 11 years,
Holm p .020 over four sports.
It failed in CFB (held t = +1.02) and CBB (held t = -0.49, with the wrong sign in tuning). MLS wasn't run.

entries.short: The model minus the market, in points (spread, total) or in chance (moneyline, tennis).
body: Edge % on the full table is the raw model chance minus the no-vig market chance.
Gaps past 5 sd are treated as bad lines, and picks between 3 and 5 sd are staked at the cap.

entries.short: A pick is the model's side when |model - line| >= X for that sport and market.
body: X is the smallest gap whose calibrated return at -103 is above 0 on the tuning seasons.
A market or segment is on only if its held-out picks beat the close (clvRet > 0, t >= 1.65, n >= 30).
There is one pick a game in each market family. Bet to is the worst line that still clears X.

entries.short: The expected return at the price, from held-out picks judged by the close.
body: Edge = min(EV, a + b (gap - mean gap)), where a blends close value and ROI, and b is the market's own slope, shrunk.
History is priced at Novig -103. TIMING .5 halves every backtest edge, since live bets come after part of the move.
The chance at the bet line is the market mid there (from both asks) plus the calibrated chance edge, with the gap measured from the market's fair line.
The NBA backtest edge is also ×.5, since the history saw tip-time injury news that the open did not.

entries.short: The stake as a % of bankroll: Kelly on the calibrated edge × the book's live realization, compounding.
body: It was formerly Dengler Units (DU), where 1 DU = 1% of bankroll. A pick qualifies where its edge at the price is above 0.
The cap is 5% a bet (tennis 2%). A joint slate Kelly gave the same growth as per-pick (rho about 0).
Walk-forward, 1× Kelly had the most log growth at the backtest edge and at half of it.

The stake multiplier r is close value per point of staked edge on the book's live picks, a normal update around .5 (sd .25), clipped 0-1. Walk-forward by game day it beat the posted stakes at the close (all books from -21.7% to -6.4% log growth, NBA from +0.81% to +1.05%).
entries.where: Predictions picks, game table, paper book

entries.short: Every flagged pick, live and paper, judged out of sample.
body: Close value and ROI with 95% ranges clustered by game day, and a one-sided p on G - 1 df.
Holm across the books (the unit that goes live or paper) and across rules with 8+ game days, family-wise .05.
Win - chance is the win rate minus the stake's chance. Brier skill is against the close's chance at the pick's price.
The venue is Novig, or Polymarket US after its taker fee (.095 p(1 - p)) when it pays more at the same line.

Polymarket's flag-time price failed its pre-registered test as a signal (143 matched picks: slope t = .47). The filter kept worse picks, and it was a noisier forecast of the close than the posted price.

entries.short: The open picks on one ET date, across all sports, are scaled to at most 40% of bankroll.
body: Stake × min(1, 40 / total). Walk-forward, P(50% drawdown) is .12, compared to .27 uncapped at 1× edge.

entries.short: Every pick is judged by the closing line first and by ROI second.
body: The close is the last snapshot before the start. CLV is the points the line moved our way.
Worth at close (clvRet) is the return the pick was worth at the closing price, with its t.
CLV needs far fewer bets than results to reach t = 2 (CBB 5+ points: about 228 compared to about 402).
entries.where: Predictions picks, paper book, picks backtest

entries.short: Opening lines that mirror the close, or that move more than 6 sd (median-based), are dropped from the history.
body: The mirrored opens were home/away swaps (mostly 2025-26 CBB neutral sites), and they inflated the backtests.

entries.short: It predicts the close from the open and the model gap (market softness b).
body: close - open = b × (model - open) + controls. b: CFB spread .10, CFB total .22, CBB .10, NBA spread .24, total .42.
The break-even gap is where a -110 bet at the open breaks even at the predicted close.

entries.short: The model total minus the mean gap between model and line over the slate and the season's last 100 games.
body: It keeps the totals picks from being a bet on the league's scoring level. Used in CFB, NBA and CBB.

entries.short: The posted picks, graded at the posted line, price and Kelly %, compounding.
body: It is identical to the picks tab, and it was reset on Oct 28 2026. No real money.

entries.short: Held-out log growth a season at the close, and the chance of a 25% or 50% fall from the peak.
body: Resampled from the walk-forward picks. Full Kelly accepts a high drawdown risk over long seasons.

entries.short: One prop per player per game, at full Kelly on Novig prices, with the week scaled to a budget.
body: P(over) comes from the projection's shape by decile, shrunk .414. Held out 2025-26: 3,732 bets at 55.3%, t = 3.1 at -110.
The weekly budget is 50% of bankroll until about 300 props are graded.

entries.short: The model's side when it differs from the Novig no-vig price by 4+ points of win chance.
body: Calibrated chance = no-vig + .5 × k toward the model (k .25 logits). The cap is 2% a bet.
Tour-level main draws, tuned on 2025 and held out on 2026: 1,935 picks, +4.5% worth at close (t = 19).
Polymarket (global) venue: tour-level main draws, 6 to 24 hours out, with the model 4+ points over the mid and the mid between 25% and 75%.
Price = ask + fee (.03 × p × (1 - p)). Tuned Oct 2025-Apr 2026: 164 picks, close value +4.2 points (t = 3.5).
Held May-Nov 10 2026: 404 picks, close value +2.2 points after costs (t = 4.5), realised +8.3% (t = 1.3). Paper stakes.

entries.short: The chance of each final set score (2-0, 2-1, ... 0-3) for a tennis match, from the match chance.
body: Each set is won with one per-match logit x + tau × e.
e is a standard normal drawn once a match, so a player who is better on the day stays better across sets.
x is solved so the set scores add back to the model's match chance exactly. tau = 1.1, fit on 2012-22 tour main draws.
Held out 2023 to Nov 10 2026 (n 20,336), exact set-score log loss is 1.2870 with independent sets
and 1.2668 with tau (t = -11.3 by tournament, 4 of 4 seasons).
It is shown under each match card's win bar. These are model numbers only, with no market line.

entries.short: Every game whose model winner is priced -200 to +200, or is the market underdog (a flip).
body: It is display only, and it isn't a pick rule. The held-out flip record across all sports is +1.2%, t = .6.

entries.short: The markets that were tested and are off, because they did not beat the close.
body: NHL (ML and totals), soccer (1X2, O/U 2.5, MLS, props), CS2 (no free closing odds) and NBA/NHL props.
Their game projections still show, and Kelly % reads off.

entries.short: The Valve Major Pick'Em picks with the best chance at each coin tier.
body: The coin has 11 challenges (Silver 4, Gold 8, Diamond 11). 5 are free and 6 take skill: 5+ of 10 in each Swiss stage, and 2 QF / 1 SF / the final in the bracket.
Stage picks are two 3-0, two 0-3 and six 3-1 or 3-2 (exact record). They are made once the stage field and round 1 are known.
A stage's picks only move that stage's chance, so every tier wants the highest P(5+ correct), which isn't the same as the most expected correct.
P(5+) comes from joint stage sims (Valve pairing, Buchholz, Bo1 / Bo3, with team strength drawn once per sim, sd .45 logit).
The search takes the exact max-expected set, then hill-climbs on P(5+), scored on a second set of sims. The bracket maximizes P(all 3).
Held out since Jul 2025 over 15 Swiss stages, the predicted pass rate was 47% and the actual was 47% (seed chalk 40%, VRS 47%).
Mean correct was 4.00, compared to 4.33 for chalk (t = -0.96), so there is no reliable edge over chalk in Swiss stages.
Max P(5+) and max expected correct pick the same set in 21 of 25 stages. Where they differ, it is under 1 point of pass chance.
In 12 held-out brackets it got 1.92 of 3 bracket challenges, compared to 1.42 for chalk and 1.50 for VRS.

entries.short: Predictive, blended and conviction mock drafts for the NFL, NBA and NHL drafts.
body: Predictive is a projection of the real draft, from consensus boards plus the model (CFB board weight .75-.85, backtested).
Conviction is the model board (FV before the consensus blend) plus team fit.
Blended puts each slot at the geometric mean of the two xPicks. Predictive and conviction grade each other.
entries.where: mock draft group on CFB, CBB, hockey prospects pages

entries.short: Expected pick, a geometric blend of the consensus average rank and the rank by our draft value.
body: The market weight is .55 + .3 × sqrt(boards / 9). Unranked prospects get .65 at 1.3× the boards' depth.
A player past the last pick is projected undrafted (UDFA signings tab).

entries.short: Teams pick on -ln(xPick) + need weight × need.
body: Need comes from the whole NFL position room: rookie-deal draft capital or salary, cut for age and expiring deals.
There are penalties for doubling up, a set QB and position runs. The QB premium at the top of the draft decays by pick.
Pre-draft meetings add +3.0 log-pick units for a top-30 visit or private workout with the team, and +1.75 for another meeting.
On real picks 1-100, 2024-26, top-1 hits go from 5.7% to 11.7%. With the weight picked on two drafts and scored on the third, it is +4.0 points (t = 2.5).
It is off until the 2027 meetings page exists (winter).

entries.short: Projected trades: the NFL on Massey-Thaler pick values, and the NBA on a Trade% for each pick. Real traded picks come from Wikipedia.
body: There are trades in every round (5, 7, 6, 5, 5, 2, 1 a round), and next-year picks are worth .48 of a mid-round pick.
A solid tag is a traded pick, and a dashed tag is a projected trade.

NBA Trade% is the chance a pick changes hands on draft night, from ln pick, its square, round 2 and ln picks the holder has, fit on Wikipedia draft pages 2008-2026, where 33% of picks were traded. Held out by draft, log loss is 0.6033, compared to 0.6123 for slot only (t = -2.0, 12/19) and 0.6364 flat.
The NBA dashed tag goes on the likeliest picks in a round, as many as the expected count (8.0 in R1, 11.8 in R2).

An NBA trade partner failed held out (top-3 hit 16%, compared to 11% uniform, t = -0.6), so no partner is named. A value chart fit on NBA trades failed against Massey-Thaler (100 pure-pick deals 2014-2026: |ln value ratio| 0.363 compared to 0.386, t = -0.8, 8/13).

entries.short: A pick the other mock takes 2.5×+ and 16+ picks later (reach) or earlier (value).
body: It is on the site table only. The GFX drops the chips.

entries.short: Simulated drafts give each prospect's pick range.
body: CFB: Gumbel pick noise by round (.40 / .525 / .625), 200 sims. CBB: a June board shock with sd 1.05 / .90 / .40 by days left.
NBA lottery and NHL order: simulated standings × lottery odds, for P(#1).

entries.short: The order comes from projected standings (NFL tiebreakers in full) and the current pick owners.
body: The NFL order uses the sim's expected slot, the NHL uses projected points and Tankathon owners, and the NBA uses lottery sims.

entries.short: A consensus of 2027 boards (.5 median rank + .5 mean), and conviction on slot plus the college line.
body: xXPM is the expected NBA peak XPM against the average drafted player, given slot and college line.
Entrants come from Dec% draws, with an FV 40+ rule for the pool.

entries.short: The draft slot a board rank points to.
body: An October board regresses toward the middle by June (Central Scouting January ranks against June slot).

entries.short: The out-of-sample checks used across the site.
body: Held out means seasons that were never used to choose terms. LOSO is leave one season out, and LOCO is leave one class out.
Prospect fits hold out whole players, classes, birth cohorts or birth years, so a player's rows stay together.

entries.short: Each game is predicted with a model fit only on the games before it.
body: Seasons are split into tuning (where terms enter) and held out (which reports and can veto). Errors are clustered by game day.
The game models tab compares live loss to the walk-forward expectation for the same month.

entries.short: I ran null inputs through the tune/held gate, and 0 of 1,200 passed.
body: 200 placebos for each sport (NBA, NFL, CBB, CFB, NHL, soccer):
rest and recent-form columns permuted across the games of a day, or swapped between teams inside a season,
stacked on the model's walk-forward number.
False passes were 0 of 1,200 under both gates (95% upper bound .31%). Held t <= -2 alone passed 4 of 1,200 (.33%; nominal 2.3%).
The held t has an sd of .89, so the clustered t is conservative, and an extra null column costs a parameter (mean t +.44).
The same recipe as a column of the real NBA design passed 0 of 200. The gate stands.
Registered Nov 19 2026: 87.7% of 24 rebuilt kept terms are forecast to keep their sign on the 2026-27 lockbox (80% interval

entries.short: One shared rule for every model term.
body: The evidence is the held-out t alone (drop-one). The tuning t is shown, but the two aren't combined. There is one Benjamini-Hochberg family over all terms with a held-out split.
A term is kept at q <= .10, and dropped at q > .10 when held-out loss is no worse without it. Otherwise it is on watch. A term with no held-out split is on watch.
Terms older than 365 days are flagged for a re-test.

entries.short: An input goes into an FV model only if it cuts held-out error.
body: Hockey, soccer and tennis: t >= 2 across held-out classes, seasons or birth years, and it wins two thirds of them.
CBB: dropping the driver has to raise out-of-sample deviance in 4 of 5 folds, with whole players held out.
CFB: the multipliers are refit leaving one draft class out, and a driver stays only if the within-position r with NFL AV improves.
entries.where: fv model tabs (drivers kept, out-of-sample evidence)

entries.short: The scorecard checks each board held out: the FV band a player was given against what he became.
body: For each band it shows the mean FV given and the mean reached (90% CI), and the predicted 40+, 50+ and 60+ odds against the realized share.
Slopes: CFB .99, CBB .97, soccer 1.01, tennis ATP .99 and WTA .97. Hockey is calibrated.
Where it runs hot: WTA 45-64 by 2.5-4.8, and CFB 40+ odds by 6-8 points at FV 40-49.
entries.where: fv model tab, fv scorecard window

entries.short: How often the outcome landed inside the printed 80% range, on seasons scored after the range was set.
body: The CBB FV range covers 91.1% (n 1199, boards 2013-16), which is too wide, since the floor at 20 sits inside most ranges.
A conformal correction leaves it at 91.0%.
The NBA 3Y (shrunk target) conformal band by projection group covers 80.3% overall, 75.9% at proj 2+ and 83.6% at 0-2.
The NHL 3Y skaters conformal band covers 77.9% overall and 75.7% at pWAR .5-2.
The tolerance was 3 points in every group of 100+. None passed, so no range on the site changed.
The CFB FV, NFL 3Y and rank ranges weren't scored, since their rows can't be rebuilt.

entries.term: Most predictive and most descriptive metric (by sport)
entries.short: Each sport's metrics scored on one test, held out, with no 2026-27 outcomes.
body: Describe: season value × season minutes summed for each team, on that season's results, held out. Predict: season n value ×
season n+1 minutes, on n+1 results, and a player's value against his next season. Tennis and CS2 use held-out matches and maps.
NBA: describe rXPM (.999), predict pXPM (.657). NFL: describe XV (.604), predict pXP/60 within position, AV for teams (.317).
CFB: describe XV (.689), predict cWAR (.256, tie XV). CBB: describe VORX on rXPM, predict pXPM in board form.
NHL: describe WAR (.978), predict pWAR for teams (.387), Marcel WAR for a player (r .446). Soccer: describe SVAR (.894),
predict p/90 (.650, r .718). Tennis: describe PA (.141), predict ARK (.107, tie Elo). CS2: describe season RWA, predict RWA rating
(next month team R² .124, player r .820), ARK for teams. The public metrics scored were nflverse EPA, PFN impact, Barttorvik PRPG,
MoneyPuck game score, FotMob rating, Transfermarkt value, official tennis rank, an HLTV 2.0 style rating and the bo3.gg rating. None of them leads.
entries.where: Every ARKBOARD: descriptive tabs lead with the describe pick, predictive tabs with the predict pick

entries.short: A game's rate minus what that opponent allowed in its other games, shrunk.
body: adjusted = value - exposure × D[opponent]. D is the opponent's allowed rate in its other games minus the league's,
shrunk toward 0 by n / (n + K). It is kept only where the odd / even game split-half r of a season rises
(paired bootstrap P >= .90 on held seasons) and the first part of a season predicts the rest no worse.
NBA lineups and on/off (held 2025-26): fives r .13 to .17, trios .35 to .41, pairs .50 to .55, on-off .22 to .24.
Soccer GAR inputs (held 2022-26): on-pitch xG for .65 to .70, against .45 to .54, buildup .64 to .65.
College basketball lineups and on/off (2025-26, 6,247 games): the opponent is its season offence and defence rating,
with schedule counted and a home term. Odd / even r: fives .18 to .25, pairs .48 to .64, on court .54 to .69, on-off .08 to .12.
First half to second half, with ratings solved apart on each side: pairs r .41 to .44 (t = -6.3), on court .46 to .50 (t = -4.4).
Failed: NHL goalie GSAx against opposing finishing (P .18 to .60), NHL lines, pairs and on-ice xG (P .02 to .77),
and NBA box value (+.003, too small to move a rank).
Already adjusted at the source: XPM, college BPM, tennis SPW+ / RPW+, CS2 and 1NT RWA, team units and every game model.
I tested weather (airport hourly observations nearest the venue), and none of it is used.
Soccer, 24,926 matches 2013-26: wet +2% goals, cold -0.7% per F under 40, wind -0.3% per mph over 10. Walk-forward totals
deviance was t = +.1 to -1.5, and xG totals were worse. Tennis, 1,125 outdoor events: +.37 serve points won and +.50 aces per 100
per 10 F inside an event (held 2020-26 t = -2.7), which is .04% of the error, and there are no match dates or forecast feed.

entries.short: A live switch that stops a losing pick rule until it is refit.
body: A rule is judged after 50+ picks, by game day, with each day over 1 + (n - 1) rho (rho is the within-slate correlation of close value on held-out picks).
It stops if the CUSUM around zero, S = max(0, S - clvRet / sd - .25), reaches 10, or if the CUSUM of the log likelihood ratio (no edge against the stakes' edge) reaches ln 99.
The last-300 clustered t (se floored at iid) is shown, but it doesn't stop a rule.
entries.where: Predictions picks backtest (rule monitor), game models tab

entries.short: A sequential test of each rule's live close value against its backtest.
body: H1 is the backtest edge × TIMING and H0 is 0, with game days deflated by the within-slate correlation of close value. A rule pauses at 19:1 for no edge, and is confirmed at 19:1 for the edge.
It takes about 250 (NBA totals) to 430 (CBB, CFB totals) bets to stop a rule with no edge.
